tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅//bcom ldan 'das 'jam

dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i chos skor la med mi rung gi gal po che/sgrub pa'i lag len gyi yi ge yang dag pa'o/ / 'jigs mdzad skor gyi yig char brdzu ba phyis kyi bsre lhad can rta khal gcig las dga' ba lags/ 'di la dkyil chog blo la byang ba gcig gis 'jug dgos te bla ma la ma zhus par dpe klogs tsam gyis mi rung ngo*// dge legs 'phel/ oṃ swā sti/ 'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi shes rab ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen pa sngon du song nas sgrub pa'i rigs rnams nyams su blang ba'i man ngag la/ [ sa bslang ba/ ] sa'i cho ga lhag par gnas pa/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga/dkyil 'khor sgrub pa/ mchod bstod 'bul ba/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ rjes kyi bya ba ste rnam pa bdun las/ dang po la sa bslang ba ni/ gtor ma sogs yo byad rnams tshogs par byas/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu/ g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang*/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs 'dzub can/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ / zhes pa'am/ yang na/ bdag nyid 'jigs mdzad nyid du bskyed kyang chog / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'am/ hrīḥṣtīḥ tshar gsum brjod/ gtor ma ya mānta ka 'am/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ind+ra ya hrīḥ zhes pa nas/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā 'i bar lan gsum dang*/ a kā ro lan bdun dang*/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ nas/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ/ gi bar gyis mchod/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/

/dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas phyir dor ro/ /'di la gtor ma dang lhan cig mchod pa'ang bshams shing dor dgos la/ mchod gtor byin rlabs kyang lhan cig yin zhing*/ bza' bca' 'bru sna gos sna glud gzugs sogs kyang gtor gsung*/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir maṇḍal byas te dri bzang gis thig le la tshom bu gcig bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ bsdu na sa'i lha mo dam tshig pa bskyed mi dgos gsung na'ang lag len mdzad pa ka shas che ste/ tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las sa'i lha mo/ gser gyi mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ lte ba yan chad sa'i dkyil 'khor nas 'thon pa/ rang gi sor mo gsum la oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya sa la brdabs/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzri bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ bsdus pa'i skabs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab med kyang chog/mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs yi ge 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pri thi wī arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du shapta 'i bar du sbyar/ oṃ mahā pri thi wī de wī/ lo ka mā ta re i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ / sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/

/lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ / rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor 'bri/ / lan gsum/ gong bzhin arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi las dang sngags kyi spyod pa ci dga' bar gyis shig ces gsungs par gyur/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ badzra tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ zhes lan mang du brjod/ sa sbyang ba ni/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na badzra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa sogs brjod cing*/ yungs kar chu shing tha la rnams kyis gtor ro/ /de nas sa bzung ba ni/ de rnams phyags mas btab ste der rang nyid 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar du gtso rkyang ngam bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs bzhin sgoms/ bdug spos btul te/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rdo rje chgaie yis/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal/ /dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stsol/ / ces lan gsum gyis snyan mnan/ mchod pa bshams shing bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhes pa nas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan brgyad sogs brjod/ bcu gsum ma'i sgrub pa byed na/ tho ba gshin rje gshed la sogs pa bzhi thugs ka nas spros/ lha dgu ro langs brgyad bskor ltar sgrub na/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma gcig thugs ka nas sprul te/ gang ltar yang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badzra bhai ra wa sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/

de bzhin du shapta 'i bar du sbyar ba phul te/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ / sogs kyis bstod/ gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /sdig pa thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /mgon pos dkyil 'khor bri bar mdzod/ / ces gsol ba 'debs te/ mchod bstod gsol 'debs sbrags pa tshar gsum mam/ re re nas tshar gsum gsum gang bde bya/ bcu gsum ma'i sgrub pa byed na/ tho ba rdo rje sogs kyis phyogs bzhi nas byed par bsams te/ mchod bstod gsol 'debs sbrags pa tshar bzhi byed pa yin mod kyi/ bstod pa ni/ dgra nag le'u gnyis pa bzhin so so dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i gsol 'debs kyang gsang 'dus bzhin byas nas 'jug tu gshin rje 'joms pa sogs byed de/ 'dir ni rdo rje ro langs mas 'jig rten pa'i lho phyogs kho na nas de dag byed de/ dmigs pa la thod mkhar gyi sgo 'am dur khrod nas so/ /de yang phyogs bzhi nas mi dgos kyi/ 'jig rten lho'am dkyil 'khor gyi shar kho na nas so/ /'dir rgyud las/ bdag dang shin tu mthun pa bzhi/ /zhes 'byung bas thob thang slob ma'am/ sgrub grogs sam/ sgrub g.yog gis gsol ba 'debs pa yin yang*/ de dag bsam pa ma dag na sgrub pa'i bar chad du 'gyur zhing*/ dus deng sang bsam pa dag la dam tshig gtsang ba dkon pas/ dmigs pa gong bzhin byas nas/ dngos su rang gis brjod do/ / oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha/ rang gi mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ rdo rje'i lta bas g.yas skor dang*/ g.yon skor du ltas nas/ bgegs rnams bsregs par gyur/ oṃ badzra dṛṣt+ri ma ṭa/ kro dha dṛṣt+ri hrīḥ kro dha dṛṣt+ri aḥ rkang mthil hūṃ las rdo rje rgya gram 'bar ba hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu bkrol/ hrīḥṣtīḥ bzla bzhin du g.yas skor du skor ba byas nas/

slar yang dbus su 'gying ba dang bcas pas/ hūṃ/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor byed/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /lus gsum las skyes 'gas par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'jig par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ / drag rol dang bcas te hrīḥṣtīḥ bzlas/ rdo rje 'chang zhes pa'i thad du/ 'khor lo 'chang*/ zhes sogs rin chen/ padma/ ral gri la yang 'don pa spo'o/ /de nas srung ba ni/ phur bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung pa'i/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can du gyur/ na maḥs manta kā ya wāka tsitta badzrā ṇaṃ/ oṃ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥ bgegs thams cad bkug ste 'brub khung gi dbus su bcug par gyur/ oṃ gha gha nas kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ bgegs la phur bus btab/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha na ha na a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum tho bas brdungs/ phur bu'i khro bo las 'od zer 'phros/ bgegs lhag ma thams cad tshar bcad/ rdo rje'i rwa ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra bha wa hūṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ spros pa la dga' na phur bu bcu 'debs/ lag len rnam grangs la phur bu stong par sbyong ba'i sngags a kā ro sa byed pa yang yod do/ /sa chog dngos de tsam gyis chog kyang*/ slar yang gnas der 'grub na sbyin sreg byed pa dang*/ de ma 'grub na tshogs 'khor dang*/ de yang ma grub na gtor chog rgyas pa re mdzad pa phyag len nges can yin no/ /gnyis pa lhag gnas ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ dpal gtor lnga dang*/ tshom bu'i rgyu dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bsags la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ ya mā nta ka sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ ā hūṃ ha ho hrīḥ

sa byin gyis brlabs/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags sam/ oṃ ind+ra ya sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bskangs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa mtha' dag mnyes par bya ba dang*/ ma lus pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams theg pa mchog gi bde ba la 'jog pa'i don du/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po srid pa gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol te/ yang dag par sgrub pa'i cho ga la 'jug par 'tshal na/ phyogs skyong ba bcu la sogs pa'i dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i tshogs rnams kyis bar chad srung ba dang*/ 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi sgrub cing dngos grub kyi gtong grogs dam pa mdzad du gsol/ nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te phyir dor/ hrīḥṣtīḥ dang bgegs mthar byed kyi gzungs bzlas la bgegs bskrad/ yang gnas dang yo byad bsangs sbyangs/ gnas khang stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las byung pa'i dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa phyi rol srung ba'i 'khor los yongs su bskor ba'i nang du/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog/bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rnams shin tu rnam par dag pa dbang sgyur ba'i rnam rig gi rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i ye shes dang*/

smon lam rgya mtsho'i mthu las grub pa/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams nam mkha'i gtos thams cad yongs su gang ba/ srid pa ji srid kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad pa 'jug par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ pādyaṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi te/ shadta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥ rū pa badzrā hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ shapta/ gandhe/rā sa/ sparshe/ oṃ aḥdharma dha tu badzra hūṃ/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum gyis rol mo'i byin dbab bo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la ba byung lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ khrag chen bsres pas byugs/ lha dgu'am/ bcu gsum gang yin yang*/ lha'i bzhugs gnas dang mthun par dri bzang gis tshom bu bkod/ gzhan phyag mtshan gyi gnas thams cad du thig le re tsam bya/ thams cad la yi ge 'bru gsum brjod/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ 'dir sa chog ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyi skabs su mdun bskyed bcu gsum ma byed pa la bdag bskyed gtso rkyang gis byas kyang rung ste gtso rkyang dang lha bcu gsum 'dam ga yin/ bcu gsum ma sgoms kyang gtso rkyang la bsdus nas mdun bskyed sgrub dgos so/ /bzlas pa yang mang du bya/ de nas mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la zhes pa nas/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i dbus su bhruṃ las mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa/ phyogs thams cad dur khrod chen pos yongs su khyab pa'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i kha dog lta bu'i steng du/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin

zhes pa nas/ lta ba yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ de nas sku las spros pa'i phyag mtshan gyi tshogs phyi rol tu 'khod pa ni/ nang gi rim pa la/ shar du mgo bo nas/ gsal shing gis phug pa'o/ /phyi'i rim pa la shar gyi g.yas su gri gug dang*/ 'phang mdung dang*/ gtun shing*/ g.yon du chu gri dang*/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang*/ lcags kyu rnams so/ /lho'i g.yas su dgra sta dang*/ mda' dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga /g.yon du dbyug tho dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ zhags pa rnams so/ /nub kyi g.yas su rdo rje dang*/ cang te'u dang*/ phub/ g.yon du gzhu dang*/ dril bu dang*/ rlung ras rnams so/ /byang gi g.yas su sdigs 'dzub dang*/ ba dan rtse gsum pa dang*/ glang po che'i pags pa/ g.yon pa tho ba dang*/ mdung dang*/ me thab rnams so/ /de'i phyi rim la phyogs bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir rab song chen po brgyad kyi gdan la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bheṃ yig nag po dang bcas pa brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ ro langs 'jigs byed chen po brgyad sku mdog nag po/ rab tu khros shing spyan gsum pa/ phyag na gri gug dang*/ thod pa'am/ ral gri dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rgyan spangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ ka ha ka ha ha la ha la zhes ljags brkyang zhing drag tu bzhad pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/

yang na ro langs rnams/ stag lpags/ sbrul rgyan/ mgo 'phreng sogs khro bo spyi dang mtshungs par byas kyang rung ngo*/ /lha bcu gsum ma ltar na gzhal yas khang bskyed/ nang gi re mig la phyag mtshan gyi steng du kṣe las gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs/ sgo bzhir ya las tho ba gshin rje gshed sogs bskyed/ grwa nang ma'i thod pa dang*/ phyi'i ro langs bzhi/ phyag mtshan gyi sdebs la bskyed do/ /'phros don no/ /de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' gdod nas grub pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu mes pas bskor ba/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ hrīḥṣtīḥ sa bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badzra sa mā dzaḥ hrīḥṣtīḥ sa bsangs/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badzra ang ku sha dzaḥ nas/ ghaṇḍe hoḥ 'i bar gyis dgug gzhug bya/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la zhes pa nas/ dharmā dhā tu pū dzi te/ zhes pa'i bar dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs phyi mchod phul/ sngags gsum gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum gsum mam bdun bdun gyis nang mchod phul/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ / zhes pa nas/ mun chen khyod la 'dud/ / ces pa'i bar dang*/ 'jam dpal mkha' las 'byung ba'i gser mdog can/ / zhes sogs kyis bstod do/ /'dir cho ga'i yan lag tu ni bum sgrub mi dgos kyang*/ sbyin sreg dang gsang byed sogs la mkho che ba'i phyir bum pa sta gon bzhin du bum sgrub byed gsung zhing lag len du yang mdzad pa'i srol gda' ste/ spro na dkyil chog tu shes par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/

gtor ma dang po dkyil 'khor la 'bul te/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ gtor ma gnyis pa dpal nag po chen po lcam dral sogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i chos skyong rnams la gtor chog ltar phul/ gsum pa phyogs skyong rnams la 'bul ba dang*/ bzhi pa gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po la 'bul ba ni/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin yin pa las/ mthar/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi zhes pa nas/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ dza ya dza ya sogs gshegs gsol dang*/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / ces sogs smon lam btab/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas snyan gsan dbab par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /rigs sngags rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /de phyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gang gzhan sngags kyi lha tshogs dang*/ /lha rnams bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin rlabs dang*/ /dngos grub dam pa stsol bar mdzod/ / ces lan gsum/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ / zhes sogs dang*/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ / sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje gtsug gtor gyi phyag rgyas nam mkhar bteg /slar yang mchod bstod snga ma bzhin byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams/ ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs nas bsrung ba chen po mdzad pa dang*/ nang par dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ hrīḥṣtīḥ lan gsum dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags lan bdun gyis bsrung ba byas la bzhag go

/gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga ni/ nangs par snga bar langs nas thig tshon rnams mkhos su phebs par bya ste/ de yang sgrub pa'i 'dra 'bag zhag bdun sogs dus yun thung ngu tsam yin na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsngags par 'dod/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis nas zla drug gi bar du byed pa rnams la ni/ chu tshon kho na bsngags shing*/ sgrub pa lan gsum du rtsom pa zla ba bco brgyad la sogs pa byed pa la ni/ zla ba drug drug nas dkyil 'khor gsar du 'bri dgos te/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig zla ba drug las lhag par 'jog pa ma bshad cing de dag so sor ma byas na lan gsum du mi 'gro bas so/ /'di la rdul tshon gyi dod du chu tshon byed pa ma gtogs/ thig tshon gyi cho ga dbang chog bzhin byas kyang legs shing*/ rtog bdun gyi rkang 'grel la sogs pa rwa lugs dang*/ skyo lugs kyi yig rnying mang po'i dngos bstan gyi dgongs pa'ang yin no/ /'on kyang man ngag gi yi ge ltar lag len 'di bzhin mdzad de/ las thig ye thig so sor byed na/ las thig bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ las byung ba'i las thig tu mos/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ brgya rtsa dang nye snying ci 'os bzlas nas/ bgegs mthar byed kyi ngo bor gyur pa la/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing*/ / sogs kyis bstod/ nye snying bzla bzhin du thig gdab/ yang bla ma'i gsung sgros las sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus pa la ni rtsig pa tshun chad 'bri ba yin zhes kyang gsung gin 'dug /phyag len yang ci rigs mdzad cing rung tsam ma yin mod kyi/ rgyud las gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgo bsrung gyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /zhes sogs/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol rnams rgyas par gsungs pas/ 'grub na dkyil 'khor rdzogs par 'bri ba nyid gal che la/

rdo rwa'i nang ngam me ri'i phyi gang du 'bri yang rung ste/ dur khrod brgyad kyang rgyas par 'bri dgos so/ /de'i phyir de dang mtshungs pa'i las thig btab zin pa na/ yangs skud pa kha dog sna lnga so sor brkyang ste/ khrag chen dang bdud rtsi lnga cung zad byugs/ bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dkar po rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo/ hūṃ las byung ba'i thig skud nag po mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ aṃ las byung ba'i thig skud ser po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo/ hrīḥlas byung ba'i thig skud dmar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ a las byung ba'i thig skud ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥtrāṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhrī hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.a hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re bzla zhing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du mos nas/ hrīḥṣtīḥ brgya rtsa brgyad kyis byin gyis brlabs/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin mchog/ sogs kyis bstod pa'am/ de nyid lnga pas bstod kyang rung*/ de nas thig skud bsgril ba'i sngags/ oṃ a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharma pa ra spa ra/ a nu ga ta sarba dharm+maḥ.aryanta a nu pra bṛṣtaḥsarba dharm+maḥhūṃ/ zhes pas bsgril zhing*/ dzdza dzdza dzdza/ zhes thig sna gtad/ oṃ āḥbadzra sa ma ya su tra ma ti gra ma hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ thig che brgyad nas brtsams te/ las thig thams cad kyi steng du 'debs tshul bya/ nam mkhang gang ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ khyod kyis 'gro don mdzad dus lags// zhes yang yang brjod/ 'di sgrub pa po gcig pus byed pa'am/ grogs dang bcas kyang slob ma'i don du ma yin pas/ phyogs 'khrul gyi nyes pa rtsi ba dang*/ thig skor sogs mi dgos gsungs so/ /gal te ye thig dang las thig gcig gis byed na/

thog mar ye thig gi cho gas thig chen brgyad sogs ji ltar 'os pa btab nas/ thig de nyid la/ bighnān ta krita dang*/ ya manta bzlas nas/ ye thig nyid las thig tu bsgyur te 'debs pa yin no/ /dkyil chog spyi'i lugs la/ las thig la byin rlabs logs pa mi dgos pa shas che yang*/ 'dir ni bla ma'i man ngag gis nges par byed do/ /de nas chu tshon nam rdul tshon rnam pa lnga la dmigs nas/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ tshon rtsi nag po baṃ las rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo/ tshon rtsi dkar po laṃ las sangs rgyas spyan ma'i ngo bo/ tshon rtsi ser po maṃ las mā ma kī'i ngo bo/ tshon rtsi dmar po paṃ las gos dkar mo'i ngo bo/ tshon rtsi ljang khu tāṃ las sgrol ma'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥmāṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥpāṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥtāṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa rnams brgya rtsa re bzla zhing*/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'byung ba lnga ni rnam dag lha/ /tshad med lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs ma lnga yi dngos/ /de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / slar yang rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ mang du brjod/ oṃ badzra bai ga a kra ma hūṃ/ zhes thig gi nang du zhugs la/ hi hi zhes sgo'i rtsa thig gyis/ chos dbyings ye shes dag pa'i gnas/ /sems can khams rnams rab sgrol byed/ /rgyal ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gnas pa'o/ / zhes brjod cing*/ lha mtshan dgod pa ni/ rgyud las/ de dbus mi ro bri bar bya/ /zhes dang*/ sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir/ ro langs chen po brgyad bri'o/ /zhes 'byung ba rnams 'dir ro langs brgyad skor ltar na/ bla ma'i man ngag gis gdan dgod pa yin no// bcu gsum ma ltar na/ re mig brgyad kyi mgo bo sogs kyang gdan du 'gyur zhing yang dbus su mi ro mgo dang rkang lag bral ba/

zhes gong ma rnams kyis bshad pa ni/ re zhig zab don sbas pa'i phyi rgya tsam yin la/ ro langs mgo gsum pa sogs kyang mchog sgrub la ma yin/ dgra bo rims kyis 'debs pa sogs drag las sam/ ro langs sgrub pa'i dbang du byas par 'dod do/ /bcu gsum ma lta bu nag po'i kha skong can yin la/ byin rlabs nus mthu che zhing dge la bkra shis pa ni yin no// 'on kyang nag po sogs rgyud gzhan gyi kha skong med par rtog pa bdun pa'i bstan tshod kyi dgongs don rgyud rkyang man ngag snying gi thig le ni/ ro langs brgyad bskor nyid la brten dgos la/ de yang slob dpon mi bskyod pa dang*/ li la badzra dang*/ mal lugs sogs ci thod thod kyis kha bskang ba ma yin par/ rje btsun rdo rje grags pa'i man ngag lag len khrigs bkod dang snying la gab pa'i yig chung bdun gyi dgongs pa ltar lag len mdzad pa'i rgyun ni/ dbus kyi mi ro lha ma yin gdan yin pa ltar sgo mtshams kyi mi ro'am ro langs kyang dkyil 'khor gyi lha ro langs brgyad po rang en cig min/ gdan yin no zhes pas nges pa las so/ /des nas rgyud kyi dngos bstan gyi tshig ltar dbus sam sgo mtshams brgyad du mi ro ri mo bri ba'am/ rnam pa gcig tu na bri pa'i don legs par 'du byed pa la'ang 'jug pas/ sngon o rgyan kha che nyi 'og sogs kyi dur khrod chen por dkyil 'khor 'bri ba na/ baṃ chen dngos su 'jog pa yin 'dug /bod du da lta de ltar mi 'grub la/ 'on kyang sha chen khrag chen bsres pa'i bag zan btsos pa la/ mi gzugs byas te tsan dan dmar pos byugs pa'am/ 'jim pa la bcos pa sogs kyang rung zhing*/ de yang rtsig pa'i nang phan chad bris zin pa na/ dbus su pad nyi'i steng du/ oṃ hūṃ hā/ zhes lan nyer brgyad bzlas pas mi ro yongs rdzogs kyi gzugs brnyan dgod/ sngags bdun ni gdan spyi la dgos/ sngags nyer gcig ni byol song bcu drug dang lha chen lnga'i don yin/

sgo bzhi grwa bzhir pad nya'i gdan med kyang chog /thig le dmar po re byas pa'i steng du/ oṃ pre tā uklā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun bzlas pas shar sgor ro langs kyi gzugs gcig gdan gyi tshul du dgod/ de bzhin du lhor/ oṃ pre ta bi mānta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ nub tu/ oṃ pre ta dzwa la hūṃ phaṭa/ byang du/ kṣi pra pre ta utka ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ nyer gcig bzlas/ mtshams bzhir/ oṃ hūṃ laṃ hā/ zhes pa kho na lan bdun res dgod/ grangs bdun la dag pa mi gsung*/ mi ro'i gzugs rnams kha bub yin/ dbus kyi mi ro'i steng du ral gri la nye snying brgya rtsa/ hrīḥṣtīḥ drug cu tsam/ ya ma rā dza/ nyer gcig bzlas te/ rtse mo gyen du brtad pas bkod do/ /sgo mtshams brgyad las sgo bzhir mi ro'i steng du/ hṛṃ hṛṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig re dang*/ mtshams bzhir/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa hrīḥha/ zhes pa nyer gcig res phyag mtshan ral gri'am gri gug gang rung re 'god do/ /phyag mtshan gzhan rnams ni rab tu 'bur ma dang*/ 'bring du tsa ka li 'god/ tha ma rdul tshon nam chu tshon gyis 'bri ba yin gsungs kyang 'bur ma yod na legs med na phyi ma gnyis po 'bring tha'i dbye ba mi yong 'dra bar mngon cing*/ gang ltar na'ang*/ nye snying bdun bdun bzla bzhin 'god do/ /der mtshan ma lha'i rang bzhin du mos pa las/ dngos sam yid kyis mchod pa 'bul/ dur khrod rgyan gyis sogs kyis bstod/ nye snying gi mthar rakṣa rakṣa btags bsrung ba bya/ bdug spos dang mar me rgyun du 'bul/ de nas dkyil 'khor lhag ma rnams bris la/ lhag chad kyi nyes pa spang ba'i don du/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol la/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ mchod pa'i bum pa brgyad kyang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags kyis phul/ mchod bum dngos su med na tsa ka li'am yid kyis phul/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs bkram/

mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ skyabs sems rdor sems/ nang mchod byin rlabs rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i tshogs zhing nas brtsams dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms/ bum pa gcig la/ bighnān ta kṛ ta dang*/ nye snying dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka 'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re bzlas la khrus bum bya/ sngar bum sgrub byas na 'di'i dod las bum gyis chog pas 'di mi dgos so/ /nyi ma thog ma'i thun dang po yin na/ zhi ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ drag po'i sgo nas/ bgegs sbyang ba bod kyi lag len spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ bar skabs su ltas 'tshub pa byung na'ang 'di byed dgos/ de min thun phyi ma dang nyi ma gnyis pa phan la mi dgos te/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzla bzhin rdo rje gsor bas bgegs bskrad pa tsam gyis chog /de rjes til sbyangs ni za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lugs bzhin gyis byur bsal/ de rjes khrus bum blangs nas khrus gsol bya ste/ de dag gi lag len spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las/ chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la zhes pa nas/ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhruṃ las 'khor lo bhruṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ nag ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du pha gu ser po la/ dra ba dang*/ dra phyed 'phyang ba/ steng mda' yab mchod rten gyi rnam pas mdzes pa/ pu sha'i khor yug la gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan bsgreng ba/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres pa/ dbus su dkyil 'khor zlum po/ mi mgo skam po'i ra ba zlum po 'dzul sgo bzhi las sgo gcig phye ba/ de'i nang re'u mig dgur gyur pa/ dbus kyi gzhi nag po'i steng*/ phyi nang gi sa gzhi thams cad khrag zhag 'khrug pa/ steng ke rus kyi ka gdung gis phub pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla bre dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang*/ rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la/ mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang*/ sgo bzhi'i thad ka nas/ ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs rnams kyi rtse mor padma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ gdugs kyis mtshan pa/ 'khyams la mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa nas/ sna tshogs pas gang ba'o 'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus kyi re mig gtso bo'i gnas su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i kha dog ces pa nas/ bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/ gyi bar sta gon gyi skabs dang 'dra/ de nas gtso bo la/

nye snying dang*/ snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags rnams lan bdun bdun bzlas/ ro langs brgyad la/ ya mānta ka dang*/ oṃ hūṃ hrīḥṣtīḥ lan bdun bdun nam gsum tsam bzlas/ gdan gyi ro langs brgyad la/ oṃ pre ta u la ka / sogs lnga'am gsum gsum bzlas pas/ de rnams ro langs bud med kyi lus can/ gzhon cing sgeg nyams dang ldan pa brgyad/ ro langs 'jigs byed chen po rnams kyi bzhon pa'i tshul du gyur/ phyag mtshan gzhan rnams la'ang*/ nye snying lan bdun bdun bzlas/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa'o/ /bcu gsum ma ltar sgrub na sta gon gyi rigs 'gre ba las lha bcu gnyis la rang sngags bdun bdun bzla/ phyag mtshan ro langs rnams la nye snying dang*/ thod pa la 'bru gsum bdun bdun bzla ba ni khyad par ro ces go bar bya'o/ /thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ mig tu kṣiṃ nas saṃ dkar po/ spyi bor oṃ nas 'khyil ba las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang*/ ro langs 'jigs byed chen po brgyad la/ 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa res dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra nas/ ghaṇḍe hoḥ de nas nyi ma thog ma'i thun dang po la sta gon gyi lha dang sre dgos te/ de yang*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkha' nas sta gon gyi lha dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ hrīḥṣtīḥ lan gsum gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ slar yang*/ hrīḥṣt+riḥ lan gsum gyis gur gyi sgo phye la nang du spyan drangs/ yang gsum gyis mtshams bcing ngo*/ / oṃ badzra lā sya hūṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ aṃ ku sha sogs kyis dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par bstim/ dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab pa'i don du sngags gsum ci rigs pa dang*/ yig brgya lan dgu bzla'o/ /lnga pa mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/

de nas slar yang mchod pa rgya cher bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shapta 'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis mchod pas kyang chog la/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na 'di skad ces sbyar te/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mi zad argha'i rgyun chen po/ /phyi nang gsang ba rab sbyar ba/ /'bul gyis 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍal sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ mi zad argha'i rgyun chen po/ / zhes pa'i dod du/ rdo rje chu gtsang khrus kyi rgyun/ / zhes dang*/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pādyaṃ zhes 'don pa spo/ de bzhin du/ rdo rje me tog khang par brtsegs// oṃ badzra bhai ra wa sa pā ri wā ra badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje bdug spos sprin tshogs 'khrigs/ /dhu pe/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang gsal gtams/ /ā lo ke /rdo rje gdung sel dri zhim tshogs/ /gandhe/ rdo rje bza' bca' rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /nai wi tye/ rdo rje rol mo'i sgra brgya pa/ /shapta/ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta zhes rol chen bya/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi na bza' zag med bde ba'i reg bya dang ldan pa mkha' dbyings thams cad gang bar gyur/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra yang*/ /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badzra bhai ra wa sa pā ri wā ra badzra bast+ra ye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan dag

/'khor lo rin chen gyis bkang nas/ /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin te/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /oṃ badzra bhai ra wa sa pā ri wā ra tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ nor bu rin chen/ ma ṇi/ btsun mo rin chen/ wast+rī/ khyim bdag rin chen/ mahā tā/ glang po rin chen/ hastī/ rta mchog rin chen/ a shwa/ dmag dpon rin chen/ khatga/ gzugs mdzes kyis ni rab bkang ste/ /rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ sgra snyan/ shapta/ dri zhim/ gandhe/ ro mchog /ra sa/ reg bde/ spar she /chos khams bde bas/ dharma dhā tu kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba lnga dag thod pa'i cod pan dang*/ / rigs drug rang bzhin rus pa'i phyag rgya drug /byang phyogs rnam dag phyag mtshan tshogs rnams kyis/ /ye shes sku la mchod cing brgyan par bgyi/ /sarba a lang ka ra/ sbrul chun tshangs pa chen po'i mchod phyir thogs/ /ā li kā li rnam dag mgo bo'i 'phreng*/ /gti mug chen po glang chen lpags pa'i gos/ /rdo rje gsum dngos phyag rgyas mnyes gyur cig /tri badzra mu dra/ dngos grub chen po brgyad dang dbang phyug brgyad/ /nyer spyad gyur las srid zhi gnon phyir dang*/ /zhe sdang gshin rje bsgral ba'i dam tshig che/ /bcu drug cha rnams dag pas mnyes gyur cig / nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas smos te/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba lan gsum gyis gtso bo dang*/ lan gcig gis re'u mig brgyad na gnas pa'i mtshan ma'i lha dang*/ ya mānta ka / lan brgyad kyis ro langs brgyad la 'bul/ ya ma rā dza dang*/ ya mānta ka 'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas rnam bu la gnas pa'i mtshan ma'i lha rnams la yang 'bul/ bar 'dir chos skyong 'jig rten 'das pa rnams la'ang 'bul/ oṃ kā la ru pa hūṃ phaṭa/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i zhal du/

oṃ hrīḥtsa muṇḍī hūṃ phaṭa/ srin mo chen mo tsa muṇḍī'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ*/ oṃ ind+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ ya mā ya/ wā ru ṇā ya/ ku be rā ya/ i shā nā ya/ igna ye/ ne ri tye/ wa ya we/ prahma ṇā ya/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇe swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun/ rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i rgyud tshim nas/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ mi thung sgeg po sprin lta'i mdog /'od zer bye ba 'phro ba bzhengs/ /mtshan ma bsgreng ba ma he'i zhal/ /gnyis med sbyor ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbyings chen po/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ khros shing rab khros cher 'khrugs pa/ /'jigs byed 'jigs par byed la 'dud/ /yan lag dgu yis chos ston zhal/ /stong nyid bcu drug zhabs kyis rol/ /byang chub phyogs chos so bzhi'i phyag /sgrib bral gcer bu khyod phyag 'tshal/ khams gsum dbang phyug ma he'i zhal/ /bden gnyis rwa yis phyogs kun gnon/ khro chags khrag 'dzag srin po'i zhal/ /rab zhi gzhon nu'i zhal la 'dud/ /'gyur med gzigs phyir byis pa'i rgyan/ /mngon byang zur phud lnga yi thod/ /kun tu dus gsum gzigs pa'i zhal/ /ljags bskyod rdo rje'i dag la 'dud/ /srid pa gsum 'joms gar gyis rol/ /zhi ba'i mtha' gnon dbu skyes 'bar/

/hūṃ phaṭa sgra yis ma rungs skrag /gsus 'phyang gtum po'i sku la 'dud/ /thod pa'i cod pan ye shes lnga/ /mgo 'phreng rdo rje yi ge'i dngos/ /rnam lnga'i rigs kyi phyag rgya can/ /sbrul rgyan tshangs phyir thogs la 'dud/ /ma rig gcod phyir gri gug ste/ /bi dhi pa las rnam rtog gcod/ /dran pa nyams 'joms gtun shing 'phyar/ /chu gris srid pa gcod la 'dud/ /sgo gsum mnyes sel ka na ya/ /sta re bag chags sra ba gcod/ /lta ngan 'bigs pa'i mdung ring po/ /mda' chen rmongs mthar byed la 'dud/ / dbang gi lcags kyu cher 'bar zhing*/ /dbyug tos las kyi sgrib pa 'joms/ kha ṭwāṃ byang chub sems rang bzhin/ /'khor los shes sgrib gcod la 'dud/ /ro mnyam ye shes rdo rje gsor/ /tho bas ser sna phye mar brlag /dngos grub brgyad ster ral gri 'phyar/ /cang te'u mchog sgra sgrog la 'dud/ khrag chen thod pa dam tshig skyong*/ /sgrib kun bcad pa'i rang byung mgo /bdud kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal phub/ /rkang bas mchog gnas srol la 'dud/ /dngos kun ye shes zhags pas 'ching*/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal gzhu thabs can/ /stong nyid sor rtog rgyu ma ste/ /shes rab dril bu 'khrol la 'dud/ /'phrin las kun 'grub lag pa gdangs/ /bdag med dur khrod bor ba'i ras/ /stong nyid rtogs pa'i gsal shing dang*/ /'od gsal me thab 'bar la 'dud/ /thod tshal snying brtse bdud rtsis brlan/ /bdud la cher sdigs 'dzub mo bsgrengs/ /sku gsum ro gcig rtse gsum 'phen/ /sgyu 'phrul rlung ras 'phyar la 'dud/ /bde chen ling ga rgyas pa'i tshul/ /gti mug glang chen lpags rlon gyon/ /brkyang bskum gar gyi zhang chen pos/ /lha chen bgegs bcas gnon la 'dud/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bdun dmar/ /ljags 'gril zhal nas ha har bzhad/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag ldan/ /'jigs mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dngos grub brgyad po stsol ba dang*/

/gdon dang nad kun 'joms mdzad cing*/ /sdang ba thams cad 'dul ba po/ /ro langs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yi ge rnams las yang dag byung*// sna tshogs mtshon cha'i dra ba dkrigs/ /mtshan ma'i lha rnams thams cad la/ / bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor ba rnam shes brgyad dag pa/ / dur khrod gnas pa'i skur ston cing*/ /sgrub la dngos grub kun stsol ba/ /'khor bcas de la'ang phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang chub phyogs chos gzhal med khang*// bka' yi 'khor los bdud bzhi 'joms/ /rnam dag rten gyi dkyil 'khor la// bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam 'gro ba rnams/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la/ /bde ba'i lam gyis 'god par shog /de ltar bstod pas ha ha hi hi hūṃ hūṃ he he zhes bzhad pa brgyad kyi gar mdzad par mos/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas yongs su zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor zhal du zhal bstan pa'i mdun gyi re mig gi gnas la 'khod par gyur/ ces pa'am/ yang na/ dbus kyi re mig gi gnas la/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du 'khod par sgoms/ kyang rung ba las phyi ma pos legs so/ /'di la 'grel pa skor gsum sogs rwa lugs dang skyo lugs kyi yi ge spyi khyab rnams las/ lho'i re mig gi lag pa'i steng du bsgom zhes 'chad cing*/ 'jig rten gyi phyogs dang dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mthun par mdzad nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs kyang bcu gsum pa ltar na/ phra ma gshin rje gshed bzhugs phyogs sam/ gzhan la lho'i re mig phyag mtshan lag pa yod pa'i phyogs su/ /gtso bo'i zhal gzigs par bshad de man ngag gab pa'am/ snying gi slob ma ma yin pa la 'dra min mgo skor gyi bshad pa yam tsam yin/ des na don nges pa can ni las dang dngos grub gang yang gtso bo nyid kyi stobs las 'grub pa'i phyir/

gtso bo zhal gzigs phyogs dang*/ phyi 'jig rten gyi phyogs bstun pas chog gi /gzhal yas khang gi phyogs nges pa dang bstun mi dgos pas/ 'dir gtso bo 'jig rten lho phyogs la mngon du phyogs pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs 'jig rten pa'i lho la ston to/ /des na gzhal yas khang ni gtso bo'i rjes su 'brang gi /gtso bo ni gzhal yas khang gi rjes su mi 'brang ngo*/ /'dir drag po'i las la 'jig rten lho phyogs su lta ba bzhin du/ rtsa ba'i sgrub pa la yang lhor blta ba yin pas rgyud 'dir phyogs kyi gtso bo lho phyogs yin par shes par bya'o/ /des na 'jig rten lho la dkyil 'khor gyi shar bstan pas gtso bo'i zhal shar gyi mgo bo la bstan pa'o/ /las so so'i don du ni shar dkar/ lho nag /nub dmar*/ byang ser du byas nas/ zhi ba la shar dang*/ rgyas pa la byang dang*/ dbang la nub ste 'jig rten gyi phyogs de dang de la gtso bo'i zhal bstan kyang legs la/ yang rtsa ba'i sgrub pa dang*/ mchog sgrub la lhor bstan pas 'grub pa bzhin du/ las de dag kyang lho phyogs su blta bas mi 'grub pa ma yin no/ /drug pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la/ dngos dang rjes kyi bya ba gnyis las dang po ni/

mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs kar sgom/ stabs bde na/ rgyu'i 'jam dpal bsgoms nas/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i tshul du sngags 'khor bsgoms/ de lta bu dmigs pa mi gsal na/ 'jam dpal zhu ba las sngags 'khor du bsgoms te/ de la sngags 'khor ni/ rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa'am/ rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa/ khong stong du gnas pa/ lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbus su hūṃ/ mtha' skor du dang por ya mānta ka dang*/ de'i phyi skor la snying po dang*/ de'i phyi skor la rtsa sngags rnams spyi dang mtshungs pa bskor zhing 'od 'bar ba zhig gsal btab/ rang gi snying gar yang de 'dra ba bsgom/ de la sgrub pa'i skabs 'di dag tu thog mar nye snying dang*/ bar du snying po dang*/ mthar rtsa sngags bzla/ bzlas pa'i gtso bo snying po yi ge bcu pa yin/ rgyud kyi rgyal po nyid las kyang*/ mnyam par bzhag pas yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang mtshon no/ /mos pa'i dbang gis nye snying gtso bor bzlas kyang rung ba tsam yin te/ 'jig rten 'das pa kho na gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /drag las sgos kyis sgrub pa yin na/ rtsa sngags bzlas pa'ang gtso bor byed dgos la/ mchog sgrub pa'am rtsa ba'i sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir/ thun gyi 'jug tu zhor bzlas kyi tshul ji ltar 'os pa re bzla'o/ /gang ltar yang dang por nye snying bzla ba na/ gzhan gnyis po blos dor te/ nye snying las tsha zer 'phros/ rdo rje'i rwa gseb nas yar me lce ltar 'ur gyis 'bar/ rtsa zhal nas 'thon pa na/ 'od zer gyi thag pa zing zing ba mang po'i gseb na/ sngags 'bru sgra dang bcas shing me stag 'bar bas khengs pa phar spros te/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i rdo rje'i rwa nang nas zhugs/ hūṃ yig nye snying gi sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas sngags 'bru rnams 'od du 'bar zhing*/

gtso bo'i sku la stobs dang bde ba rgyas/ thugs mchog tu mnyes par gyur/ yang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon nye snying dang bcas pa las/ phar spros pa kho na 'dra ba'i 'od zer sngags 'bru dang bcas pa rnams byung*/ bdag nyid kyi ma he'i zhal nas zhugs te/ snying ga'i sa bon nye snying dang bcas pa la thim pas/ yig 'bru 'od du 'bar/ bdag bskyed kyi lha stobs dang bde ba dang dga' ba rgyas par bsam/ dmigs pa myur bul gyi dbye bas/ de lta bu lan gsum dang lnga sogs ji ltar 'os pa song ba na/ rang gi zhal nas spros te mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim pa yang rgyun mi 'chad par 'jug cing*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dang*/ sngags 'phreng 'og tu 'phros/ lte ba nas 'thon/ rang gi lte ba nas zhugs/ rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje'i 'og rwa nas brgyud de sngags 'khor la thim par mos la/ sngags brgya'am stong sogs bzlas/ yang de go spos te/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dang sngags 'phreng 'og tu 'phros lte ba nas 'thon/ mdun bskyed kyi lte bar zhugs/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ yang mdun gyi sngags 'khor las 'od dang sngags 'phreng byung*/ mdun bskyed kyi ma he'i zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi rtsa zhal du zhugs nas snying ga'i sngags 'khor la thim pa'ang rgyun mi 'chad par bsams shing*/ sngags brgya'am stong sogs bzla'o/ /'dir sngags kyi thag pa bzhi sbrag ces zer zhing*/ phar 'khor tshur 'khor gnyis kar dus mnyam du byed par 'dod pa zhig yod de/ sgom tshul mi bde bas lag len du mi mdzad do/ /bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa mchog sgrub tu byas pas phyis las tshogs thogs med du 'grub pa yin/ bsnyen pa'i dus nas dgra bsad kyi dmigs pa ga byed pa ni rang bsam pa ngan pa kho nar zad do/ /de nas snying po bzla bar 'dod na/ dmigs pa gzhan rnams de kho na dang 'dra ba las/

sngar nye snying gi sngags 'phreng de snying po la thim/ rnam pa snying po kho na la/ ngo bo snying po dang nye snying gnyis ka yin par mos dgos pa ni khyad par ro/ / rtsa sngags bzla tshul yang phal cher de dang 'dra ste/ dang por snying po'i sngags 'phreng rnams yi ge so gnyis pa la thim/ rnam pa rtsa sngags la rang bzhin sngags gsum char gyi gzhi mthun par mos nas bzlas pa byed dgos pa las/ rtsa sngags 'di 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sngags ltar bzla na/ de phyin chad kyi dmigs pa ni snga ma rnams dang 'dra/ 'jig rten pa ltar bzla na/ bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ 'jig rten dregs pa thams cad kyi snying ga nas/ yig 'bru so gnyis bkug /bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i sngags 'bru rnams kyi zhabs nas thim/ 'o ma rnam par 'gyur ba zhor song ba bzhin du sngar sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi snying po kho na yin pa de/ da ni 'jig rten dregs pa rnams kyi srog gi snying por yang song ba'o/ / snyam du mos/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las thig le dmar tsher pa re spros te/ yi ge rnams kyi mgo la thim pas/ dregs pa thams cad kyi srog dbang du 'dus par bsam/ de nas dmigs pa gzhan thams cad 'dra ba las/ rtsa zhal nas 'gro 'ong mi byed/ rang nyid kyi steng zhal dmar po'i zhal gyi sgo nas 'thon/ mdun bskyed kyi steng zhal du 'jug pa dang*/ tshur 'ong ba'i tshe yang de dang 'dra ste/ 'di tsam khyad par ro/ /de yang nye snying stong tsam song na/ hrīḥṣtīḥ lnga stong tsam/ ya ma rā dza/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i tshul brgya dang 'jig rten pa'i lugs brgya/ yongs dril nyis brgya bzla ba lta bus mtshon te/ mang nyung de'i rig pas dpyad/ spyir ni sngags gsum po gang rung gcig kho nas kyang 'grub pa yin mod/ lag len gyi rgyun la gsum kar bzla ba yin/ snying po la yang 'jig rten 'das ma 'das kyi lugs gnyis ka sbyor du rung ba cig dang nye snying la yang de 'dra gcig go babs la yod mod kyang*/

phyag len la ni mi mdzad de/ nye snying dang yi ge bcu pa 'di dag 'jig rten 'das pa kho na byas pas byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che zhing bkra shis la/ rtsa sngags la gnyis kar byas pas las myur ba yin/ sngags gsum kar la 'das ma 'das gnyis ka'i bzlas pa byas na/ 'jig rten pas shed khyer ba'i rnam par song nas rtsub cing bkra mi shis par 'gro nyen yod gsungs/ yang de dag la man ngag gi gnad gal chen gcig ni/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i sngags bzla lugs kun la/ sngags dang 'od zer las mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul te/ bdag mdun gyi lha dang*/ thugs ka'i sngags 'bru la mchod par bsam/ sngags rnams zhal dang lte ba nas 'khor ba'i skabs/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas mchod sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim par bsam dgos/ 'jig rten pa'i skabs/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo las bdud rtsi'i bum pa spros te/ dregs pa rnams kyi spyo bo nas dbang bskur bas/ gnod sems zhi/ bde ba dang ldan par byas/ de rjes srog sngags bsdu ba sogs byed pa gnad yin/ khyad par sngags zhal dang lte ba nas 'khor ba'i skabs/ 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dpag tu med pa spros/ 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang phyi rol dregs pa rnams la phog pas/ bde ba thob cing dbang du bsdus/ 'od zer tshur bsdu ba'i dmigs pa byed pa'ang gnad gcig go /mchog sgrub la 'khor gyi bzlas pa med kyang chog mod de/ phra mo las tshogs sgrub pa la 'khor gyi sngags kyang bzlas na bzang bas/ oṃ āḥbha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hṛṃ hṛṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa shar gyi ro langs dang*/ de bzhin du/ oṃ āḥbhi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hṛṃ hṛṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ lho phyogs dang*/ bhu nub phyogs dang*/ bhai byang phyogs dang*/ oṃ āḥbho hūṃ phaṭa hṝḥhā/ shar lho dang*/ yang de bzhin du/ bhau lho nub dang*/ bhaṃ nub byang dang*/ oṃ āḥbhaḥhūṃ phaṭa hṝḥhā/

byang shar gyi ro langs kyi sngags so/ / de bzhin du/ gdan ro langs ma rnams kyi sngags ni/ oṃ hṝḥhā hūṃ shrī phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa kho na bzla ste/ de rnams thams cad la bdag bskyed dang*/ gtso bo gnyis kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng rnams zhu ba las/ 'khor de dang de dag gi sngags su gyur/ gang la bzla ba'i 'khor de nyid kyi thugs kar yang nyi ma la bhaiṃ/ de'i mtha' skor du rang sngags kyi bskor ba bsgoms nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung*/ ro langs kyi thugs kar zhugs/ sngags rnams la phog pas bde ba thob cing dgyes par bsam/ yang de'i thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng byung*/ rang nyid kyi lte ba nas zhugs/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ dkyus su bshad pa 'di ro langs brgyad kar las kyi 'jigs byed pho brgyad mo brgyad du sgrub pa'i lugs yin/ gzhan gshin rje pho mor sgrub pa dang*/ srin po pho mor sgrub pa dang*/ dbang phyug pho mor sgrub pa dang*/ srin po dang las kyi 'jigs byed 'dus pa mgon po nag por sgrub pa'i lugs kyang yod de/ sgrub pa gcig gi dus su sgrub lugs so so'i bzlas pa gnyis byed du mi rung la/ dus skabs so sor dkyil 'khor logs pa re bzhengs na/ sgrub tshul mi 'dra ba so so thams cad kyang gang zag gcig gis sgrub tu ni rung ngo*/ /de ltar na yang*/ rang gi skal ba dang gang 'tsham pa gcig kho na bla ma'am lhag pa'i lha la lung bstan zhus te bsgrubs na legs so/ /'khor sgrub tshul mi 'dra ba de rnams las don gyi gtso bo ni las kyi 'jigs byed pho mor sgrub pa yin no/ / rang lugs kyi sngags pa gong ma mang po yang sgrub tshul tha dad de dag phal cher/ tshar re mdzad pa'i srol yod de/ blo sna mangs la khad do snyam mod lag len mi nub pa'i dgos pa ni yod do/

/yang gshin rjer sgrub pa dang*/ srin po dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ mgor por sgrub pa rnams las rang rang gi sgos bsnyen re sngon du btang na legs/ las kyi 'jigs byed brgyad sgrub pa la ni/ gtso bo kho na'i bsnyen pa song bas chog go gsungs/ yang de rjes skabs 'di'i cho ga yan lag tu dgos pa ma yin yang*/ yig chung zur na yod pa ltar*/ mgon nag dang*/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ las kyi gshin rje ha la nag po dang*/ lha mo re ma tī dang*/ srin po pho mo rnams kyi bzlas pa yang cud zad re byed pa'i srol yod la/ mthar sumbha 'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad de/ gtso bo la yi ge brgya pa bdun dang*/ 'khor rnams la lan re tsam bzlas pas brtan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rjes kyi bya ba ni mchod gtor te/ de yang arghaṃ sogs phyi mchod dang*/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod dang*/ hūṃ/ dur khrod rgyan sogs kyis bstod nas/ gtor chog dkyus kyi sngon du 'jam dpal rdo rje'i 'jigs byed kyi sgos chos lha bshos kyi gtor ma chen po 'bur bar bya ste/ de yang rgyud las/ mi la sogs pa bcu gcig dang*/ bya rgod sogs la bcu gcig yod mod kyi/ lag len du zhabs 'og gi srog gzugs dngos dang mthun par/ brgyad tshan gnyis kho na mdzad do/ /srog chags rnams kyi sha khrag rus pa bsres pa'i gzugs brnyan bya bar bzhed na bya chen po la srin bya'am 'ol ba'o/ /de dag ma rnyed na bag zan btsos pa dang sha khrag bsreg shing srog chags de dang de'i ngo bor mos/ 'jig rten gyi phyogs dang bstun nas/ shar du ce spyang lhor ma he/ /nub tu khyi ste bong bu byang*/ /shar lhor lug dang srin por mi/ /rlung du rnga mo byang shar glang*/ /de dag re re yi g.yon du/ /bya rgod shar dang 'ug pa lho/ /bya rog nub dang khra ni byang*/ /ne tso dbang ldan 'ol ba me/ /lho nub ri skeg bzhad dkar rlung*/ /zhes pa ltar/

thams cad kha nang du bltas te 'god pa bya la/ nyin re bzhin nam/ thun re bzhin gzugs brnyan gsar pa tshar re 'bul ba yin na/ de dag kho nas chog gzhan ling ga mi dgos la/ sgrub pa'i dang por lan cig bshams pa de nyid thun re'am/ nyin rer mtheb kyu phra mos kha gso ba tsam las mi byed na/ 'brub khung gcig tu ling ga chung ngu gcig kyang bsham mo/ /de thams cad gu gul gyis bdugs/ nang mchod dang raktas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ yig rnams las byung pa'i srog gzugs rnams phung po khams dang skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa/ dam tshig gi nyer spyod ma tshang ba med par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum sogs kyi byin gyis brlabs/ re re la dmigs na kha 'bar ba'i sngags lan gsum gsum mdzad pa'i srol yang yod/ rkang bzhi brgyad po rnams rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs brgyad dang*/ 'dabs chags brgyad po rnams sdig pa'i las brgyad du mos/ de la nyon mongs pa brgyad ni/ dug lnga lta ba the tshom g.yo sgyu'o/ /mi dge ba brgyad ni/ mi dge bcu las/ log lta nyon mongs kyi sdebs la songs/ brnab sems gnod sems gcig tu sdoms pa'o/ / de ltar mos nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan 'ga' re brjod/ de nas dgug gzhug bya ste/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa dam pa'i chos rnams kyi= theg pa gsum la gnas pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi= yi dam dkyil 'khor kyi lha rnams kyi= de bzhin bshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ las kyi rigs su zhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang/ rigs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dus gsum kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang*/

gsung dang*/ thugs rdo rje'i khro rgyal chen po gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= bka' sdod phyag brnyan dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs kyi= chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i= kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i= rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyis= spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig par byed pa/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ mi dge ba bcu dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa sdig pa'i las la rtag tu spyod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la brnyas shing mtho 'tsham pa ma rungs pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par rnal 'byor sgrub pa po bdag la zhes pa lta bu skabs su gang babs kyis mtshams sbyar nas/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas gnod par byed pa'i snga dgra lag la bdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da lta mngon du gyur pa'i las ngan gyi dgra bgegs/ dngos grub dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bsam pa la bar du gcod par byed pa dang*/ thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa la log par sgrub par byed pa dang*/ tshe dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ bde ba dam pa la mi mthun par rtsom pa/ mdor na chos dang*/ 'byor pa'am/ phan pa bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod par byed pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu rab 'byams na gnas pa/ 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i sems can ma lus pa'i las ngan pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa thams cad gnod byed gdug pa can gyi gzugs su bsgyur te/ de dag thams cad zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus drangs/ thabs sna tshogs pas rab tu bsdigs te skad cig /thang cig /yud tsam 'di nyid la gzugs brnyan 'di rnams la mi 'tshor bar phob cig /hrīḥṣtīḥ

'i mthar/ sarba pā paṃ bighnān shā trun a karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ ṇ-i yaṃ dzaḥ tri yaṃ dzaḥ oṃ badzra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pa sha hūṃ/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra a be sha a/ zhes pa lan gsum dang*/ hrīḥṣtīḥ 'i mthar/ sdang ba dang gdug pa thams cad a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes spel ba nyer gcig nas/ brgya'i bar ji ltar 'os pa bzlas pas dgug gzhug bya'o/ /de 'dra lan gsum byed/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa dang sdig pa rnams dgra bgegs kyi rnam par bkug nas/ byol song bcu drug la bstim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ de rjes thun re'am zhag rer srog gzugs rnams brje zhing 'bul na/ srog gzugs bcu drug po sgrol/ sgrub pa'i 'go gzhug la/ kha gso ba ma gtogs srog gzugs tshar gcig po des skyong na/ phur bu dang*/ ral gri thogs nas/ srog gzugs rnams la brdeg pa'i tshul tsam byas nas/ lung chung de la dngos su btab ste bsgral lo/ /spros pa byed na phyag mtshan tsho yang 'debs te bzlas pa la g.yel bar 'gro bas mi bya la/ phur bu ni spyi mthun yongs su grags pa ltar yod na legs mod kyang*/ ma 'byor na lcags sam/ rus pa'am/ tsher ma can gyi shing la mgo bor 'dzin yod pa/ gzer bu'i rnam pas kyang rung zhing*/ khab long bas kyang rung gsungs/ gang ltar yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phaṭa yig las byung ba'i phur bu dang*/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i ral grir gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥbi kri tā na na sarba pā paṃ shā trun bighnān kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun bzlas te phur bus snying gar btab/ yang oṃ hṝḥṣtīḥbi kri tā na na sarba pā paṃ/ sarba shā trun b-ighnān mā ra ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun bzlas pa'i mthar/ sngags de nyid bzla bzhin du thog mar gzugs brnyan gyi mgrin pa nas bcad de/ mthar dum bu mang por gtubs/ de rnams snod gcig tu spungs la/ raktas cung zad bran te/ stegs bu'i steng du bzhag /spros pa la mos na/

lha thams cad kyi zhal du 'debs pa'i tshig byang yang brjod/ bsdu na yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ badzra bhai ra ba a ti pa ti i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dkyus la brgya rtsa sogs dang las yin na las kyi grangs dang mthun par phul/ rje'i rjes su sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ gtor ma byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ gtor 'bul rgyas par bya'o/ / bdun pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ thun gyi rjes chog dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mchod pa gsar ba bshams shing*/ rnying pa rnams kha gso/ byin rlabs bsdus pa gong bzhin bya/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa mdor bsdus rnams byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang gdon dang bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ dbang phyug dam pa phun sum tshogs pas 'gro ba thams cad byang chub la yang dag par gzhug pa dang*/ sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems can zhi bas mi 'dul ba rnams drag po'i 'phrin las kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub dam pa ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rang bzhin rnam par dkar ba'i lam rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi bdud dang nyon mongs rtsa ba dang dri mar bcas pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du gzhom par mdzad du gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang theg pa bde ba dang*/

lam bde ba dang*/ 'jug pa bde bas thob par mdzad du gsol/ ji srid go 'phang mchog de nyid ma thob pa'i bar du yang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa la sogs pas gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyis stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pas bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes bya cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ / mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun gtso bos bzod mdzad rigs/ /dkyil 'khor dang rten la sgrub pa ma thon bar dang rtag pa'i brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / ces pa'am/ bdag la dngos grub mchog bstsal lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsal/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa'ang bstsal/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas gshegs badzra muḥ /zhes gtor mgron rnams gshegs/ yang gong ma 'ga' zhig ni dam can rnams gshegs su ma gsol/ bar dpang bor bzhag kyang legs zer ba'ang snang ngo*/ /de rjes bdag dang dkyil 'khor la srung ba dang*/ smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brten no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu ni/ sgrub pa thon pa'i skabs dgos pa yin te phal cher bshad ma thag pa'i rjes chog dang 'dra yang khyad par phra mo rnams dbang chog tu bshad pa bzhin te/ 'on kyang rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren mi mdzad do/ /de ltar na skabs 'dir bkra shis yan chad bya ste/ thun dang po'i cho ga'o/ /thun phyi ma rnams la/ bdag bskyed rgyas par ma 'grub kyang rung ste/

rang skad cig gis 'jigs mdzad chen po'i skur gsal btab/ sngags gsum po gang 'os re bzlas nas mdun bskyed kyi cho ga la 'jug pa sogs gzhan rnams 'dra'o/ /nyer sgrub kyi skabs 'dir/ sbyin sreg ji ltar 'os pa bsgrubs te/ rab tu nyin re bzhin sbyin sreg lan re bya na/ thun dang po'am/ gnyis pa gsum pa'i 'jug gi thun mtshams gcig la bya/ thun tha ma'i 'jug la phyi rol gtor ma'i tshul du sgrub khang gi sgo phyir drug cu rtsa bzhi re 'bul/ cang te'u 'khrol zhing nang du 'ongs nas/ sngags gsum gyi mthar/ ha ha hi hi he he ho ho zhes bzhad pa brgyad kyi nga ro dang bcas nas skor ba byed cing dkyil 'khor du zhugs par mos te/ de nas rjes chog rnams bya'o/ /'bring du na/ zla ba drug lta bu la yar ngo mar ngo gnyis ka'i brgyad dang bcu dang bco lnga la sogs par sbyin sreg re bya la/ tha mas kyang thog mtha' bar gsum du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /gtor ma ni rab thun bzhi/ 'bring thun gnyis/ tha ma srod dam nam phyed la re re'o gsung ste lha bshos kyi dbang du byas pa yin gtor chog dkyus de thun re bzhin dgos so/ /de ltar na bla ma gong ma rnams tshul 'di la bsnyen sgrub sgrags ma zhes tha snyad sbyor la/ spyir 'di la nye bsnyen dang*/ nye sgrub ces bsnyen pa che shos dang*/ sgrub pa chung ba'i don yin pas/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa gnyis ka'i cha 'dzin pa yin no/ /'ga' zhig sgrub bsnyen zhes pa'i tha snyad byed pa yod pa'ang 'di la zer na ni 'gal ba med kyi/ phyis byung gi sgrub thabs bzhad sgra zer ba gcig na/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa'i skabs/ mdun na rten gang yang med pa la/ skad cig gis lha mdun du spyan drangs nas/ dgra bsad kyi dmigs par rlom pa 'dra byed pa de la sgrub bsnyen zer zhing*/ rtsub po yod do drag la myur ba yin no/ /zhes smra ba ni man ngag med kyang*/ man ngag yod par rdzu ba ste skyo lugs kyi sgrub thabs cig mig zur la thogs pas/

de dang 'dra min byas par snang mod/ rtsub cing myur la re yang*/ ngal ba 'bras bu med par zad do/ /lar yang yon tan gzhan med na rtsub pa kho na dgos pa cig yod/ deng sang gi sngags pa phal che bas/ sgrub pa'i 'dra 'bag tsam ma gtogs/ sgrub pa dngos lag len du thebs par dka' ba'i phyir/ deng sang gi sgrub pa lag len du 'debs rgyu la bsnyen sgrub ma 'di la gal che shos yin no/ / de nas sgrub pa dngos kyang phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ 'dra 'bag lam du byed na/ dmigs pa'i khyad par mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i gong du bdag mdun bsres te/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros nas sangs rgyas thams cad mchod de byin rlabs bsdu ba nyid gtso bo yin la/ yang rang nyid thugs ka nas phyir byung*/ khyad par gyi bshos gtsang 'bul ba zhes pa lha bshos kyi gtor ma man chad bya'o/ /rab tu thun bzhi'i thun mtshams thams cad la sbyin sreg dang phyi rol gtor ma gnyis ka 'chag med du bya/ rang gis ma lcogs shing grogs rnam dag cig yod na grogs kyis byas kyang rung*/ ma tha yang zhag re'i thun mtshams gang yang rung ba cig la/ sbyin sreg lan re ni 'chag med du dgos/ yo byad ye ma 'dzom zhing dmigs pa gsal na/ rdzas kyi sbyin sreg ji ltar 'os pa byed cing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyin sreg thun bzhir bya'o gsungs te dmigs pa gsal bo dkon/ 'di zla phyaid sogs byed na sgrub pa dngos la gnyid spong dgos pa'i tshab/ mtshan mo'i dus grogs kyis sngags thun bzung bas chog go /sgrub chen gyi 'dra 'bag ni/ thod pa'am/ snod dge zhing shis pa gcig tu sha chen la sogs pa dam rdzas ji ltar 'os pa bzhag pa'am yang zhun mar ram/ gi haṃ la sogs pa bzhag kyang rung*/ de dkyil 'khor gyi re mig dbus ma'am mdun mar bkod/ gzhan sgrub pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ sgrub rdzas de bsangs sbyangs sngags gsum ka'am/ gang rung cig gi yig 'bru'i phung por mos/

bzlas pa'i skabs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sngags 'bru rgyun mi 'chad par spyan drangs/ rdzas la bstim zhing*/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe bsrung ba bya/ nub snga ma rnams la rjes chog gi skabs gsol ba drag tu 'debs shing*/ zhal gyis bzhes par bsam pa lhag po yin gzhan 'dra'o/ /nub tha ma nam phyed dam/ tho rangs kyi dus su/ thun grol mtshams kyi phyi rol gtor ma song nas/ nang du 'ongs te dngos grub stsol bar gsol ba drag tu btab pa na/ khyod dngos grub ci 'dod ces gsung bar bsams/ 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i sku thob par 'gyur ba/ rdo rje tshe'i dngos grub bcud len gyi mchog stsal du gsol zhes pa lta bus gsol ba btab pas/ sngar gyi sgrub rdzas de nyid der byin gyis brlabs te/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yon pas rang nyid la bstsal bar bsam/ sgrub rdzas lag gnyis kyis blangs te/ yi ge 'bru gsum brjod bzhin du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ phud sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la yid kyis phul/ sems can thams cad kyi dngos grub 'di thob par gyur cig snyam du rang gis zos shing 'thungs pa/ dngos grub de thob par mos pa bya/ de rjes slar yang sbyin sreg dang*/ nang gtor bsdus tsam re bya/ yang na sgrub rdzas logs pa mi byed par de'i don du dkyil chog las 'byung ba ltar gyi bum sgrub byas nas sgrub rdzas 'jog sar bum pa bkod/ dngos gzhi'i skabs dmigs pa sogs 'dra/ skabs 'dir rdzas kyi dngos grub len pa'i tshab tu/ bdag 'jug gi sgo nas bum dbang yongs rdzogs sam/ chu dbang tsam blangs pas kyang*/ dgos don snga ma dang 'dra ba las shin tu byin rlabs che ba yin/ 'on kyang rdzas kyi sgrub pa'i lag len mi nub pa'i phyir/ lag len snga ma de yang nges par mdzad do/ /de rjes sngon bzhin rjes chog dang*/ dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol bya/ slar yang nyi ma gzhan la dkyil 'khor gyi shul der/

sbyin sreg dang gtor ma dang tshogs 'khor la sogs pa bya'o/ /sgrub pa sgrub chen 'di dag 'dra 'bag tsam yin yang*/ mthu stobs nus pa dang*/ tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba sogs byin rlabs kyi tshan ka chen po 'byung ngo*/ /gal te bsnyen sgrub bsgrags ma la/ yo byad sogs ye ma 'byor na/ dmigs pas dkyil 'khor bsgoms/ dngos su bris sku tsam la brten kyang chog go /zhes gsung ngo*/ /de ltar na tshul 'di ni/ las mtha' dag la thun mong du 'jug pa dang*/ mchog sgrub bam dngos grub sgrub pa'i don yin/ 'di'i steng du drag las kyi khyad chos 'ga' zhig bsnan te/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma dang sgrub pa las sbyor sogs byed tshul ni/ 'grel pa skor gsum dang*/ lag len khrigs bkod sogs na gsal ba ltar shes dgos mod kyi/ dgra bsad tsam la dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma zla drug sogs phyed rin mi chog go /bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma dang*/ sgrub pa sgrub chen gyi skabs 'di dag lag len ston byed dam/ 'dra 'bag tsam gyi skabs yin yang rung*/ nyer sgrub dang sgrub pa dang sgrub chen gsum dkyil 'khor bzhengs theng gcig gi steng nas byed du mi rung ste/ cho ga tha dad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas re re bzhin dkyil 'khor snga ma snga ma gshegs su gsol nas/ phyi ma phyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsar du bzhengs dgos pa yin no/ /dkyus thog cig la dkyil 'khor bzhengs sa khang pa gcig tu byed pa yin na/ sa chog gcig gi sa rung bar kha cig 'dod la/ lag len du ni rang gi sems kyi dri ma sbyong ba'i gnad dang*/ dgos don tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ re re bzhin sa chog byed dgos zhes gsung ba ltar mdzad do/ /'dir dngos su bshad pa'i sgrub pa'i rim pa 'di rnams mchog sgrub ces bya ba yin te/ de yang rgyud 'di'i lugs la mchog ces pa phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kho na la go dgos pa ma yin/

dngos grub spyi la zer ba yin/ rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang po'i mchog ces pa'i dgongs pa'ang 'di kho na yin no/ /thog ma dgra bsad lta bu'i las nye tshe ba re la yid dga' drangs te bsnyen sgrub rnams byas su zin kyang*/ skabs der las te cung zad 'grub srid mod/ ji skad du/ lha ni mnyes par ma byas na/ /bdag nyid rnam par sun 'byin yin/ / zhes pa ltar yul chung zhing bkra mi shis la/ dngos grub kyi rten 'brel 'grig par mi 'gyur ro/ / mchog sgrub kyi don du/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen sgrub 'di mchod pa la brtson pa dang bcas pas sgrubs na/ gzhi nas lha mnyes pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ phyis las gang la sbyar yang 'grul sla zhing*/ las stobs che 'khu ldog sogs bkra mi shis pa mi 'byung la/ sgrub pa dngos ma yin sgrub pa'i 'dra 'bag tsam yin du chug kyang*/ phyis dngos grub thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grig cing*/ da lta 'phral du'ang las thams cad pa'i cho ga bzang por 'gyur ro/ /rtsa ba'i sgrub pa 'di rnams 'thems par song na/ phyis las sgrub pa'i tshe/ sngon gyi yig rnying rnams las gsal ba ltar/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ram/ de yang ma 'grub na/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ nye bsnyen dang*/ sgrub pa las sbyor rnams/ zhag bdun phrag sogs ji ltar 'os par kyang legs par 'grub la/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa 'cha' mi 'thub na/ maṇḍal chos 'byung ngam/ thang ga'i drung du sbyin sreg/gtor ma/ 'khrul 'khor rnams bsgrubs pas kyang legs par 'byung ngo*/ /sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir gong ma rnams kyi yi ge na/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi sgrub pa'am/ dngos grub dang las phyogs re'i sgrub pa zhes so sor phye ba gsal po mi 'dug pas/ dbye ba 'di ltar byed pa mi rung ngo snyam pa'i log rtog gam/ yang na dbye ba 'di dgos phyin snga ma rnams kyis ma go zhing nor ba'o snyam pa'i log rtog 'byung srid na/

de ni gnyis ka ma yin te/ dbye ba byed pa ni/ gtso bor rtog bdun nyid dang*/ gzhan yang bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud rnams kyi spyi'i dgongs pa yin zhing*/ yang sgos su bla ma dam pa'i man ngag zhal rgyun rgyud dang 'grel pa la 'dzug tshugs su ngo sprod pa'i srol ka ma nyams pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'khrul pa dang 'dzol so ye med pa la/ byin rlabs dang*/ nus pa yong 'phro rgyun ma chad pa'i nyams myong gis grub pa yin no/ /yig rnying byed pa po rnams kyis kyang ma go ba ta ma yin/ skye bo blo dman pa drag las kho na la sems shor ba rnams kyi ngor/ dgra bsad 'ba' zhig la sbyar ba ltar byas nas de'i khog nas mchog sgrub 'don rgyu yin zhing*/ de bla ma'i zhal 'khrid la brten nas sgrub dgos pa yin yang*/ bar skabs nas gzung ba'i dge bshes kyi ming can dang*/ sngags chos shes 'dod chos thob la brtson pa'i 'dun pa che chung su 'dra ba cig yin yang*/ phal mo che zhig bla ma yun ring du bsten pa'i sgo nas/ mnyes pa'i thabs ye mi byed pas gser dang 'dra ba'i 'dra men gyi dper song*/ zhal shes lag len gyi gnad rnams rim pas rtsa bas chad pa ltar song ba yin/ sngon gyi rig sngags 'chang rnams kyis/ zhal shes dang thugs bcud thams cad yi ge 'god pa ga la zhig /'phral gyi lag len phra mo rnams kyang*/ ngag rgyud dang mthong ba rgyud pa kho na la gnas pa mang*/ des na gsang sngags kyi man ngag zab mo de ltar gab pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa ni/ dgos nges shes pa'i phyag srol yin pas/ gsal bor yi ge la mi 'god pa dang*/ 'dra mid mgo skor zhal rgyun dang 'dzug 'khrid kyi khungs tshol yang 'byung ba de/ sngon gyi rtsom pa po rnams mi mkhas pa yang min/ mkhas kyang bsam pa ngan pa'ang min/ yig rigs de dag ngan par yang mi 'gyur mod/ slob ma tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir/ bla ma la bsnyen bkur byed pa'i thabs yin no/

/yang phyis 'ga' zhig ltar rtsom pa pos thog ma nyid nas bla ma'i zhal lung ma thob par rig pa glegs bam las bklags pa dag gis/ rang bzo'i yi ge bkod pa dag la/ slad nas gser chos dang snyan brgyud dang*/ zhal shes dang*/ 'dzug 'khrid kyis ming btags pas mi phan gyi/ sngon nas da lta'i bar rgyun ma chad pa'i zhal lung man ngag dgos so/ /rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i lag len la/ gcig tu rang gal che ba sgrub pa'i skor gyi lag len 'di dag yin yang*/ sgrub dkyil gyi yig cha gsar pa re thams cad kyis brtsams pas mang grags pa'i skyon dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi bshad pa yam me ba yang mang po brtsams 'dug kyang*/ sgrub pa byed tshul gyi lag len ngag 'don bris pa ye ma mthong zhing*/ phal cher la de ltar dgos pa'i go ba tsam yang mi snang bas/ 'dir phyogs tsam brjod pa yin no/ /zhes pa'ang 'jam dpal khro bo dang gnyis su med pa rtsa ba'i bla ma tshul khrims rnam rgyal dang*/ de'i thugs sras don grub legs pa'i bka' drin las gsung ngag dang phyag len gyi rim pa legs par thob pa rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// //
